record.reason: The coauthor dissertation chapter describes MITTA for multi-task NLP and vision inference, identifying BERT and ViT workloads; its methods include shared base-task weights/activations, sparse task deltas, INT8/INT4 and DVFS. It does not evaluate LLM inference.
record.title: MITTA: A Multi-Task Transformer Accelerator With Mixed Precision Structured Sparsity and Hierarchical Task-Adaptive Power Management
